h1: Custom Set in Sleeve T Shirts
metaTitle: Custom Set in Sleeve T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom set in sleeve t shirts for a classic fit. Perfect for teams and events. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Set in sleeve t shirts offer a classic, structured fit that stays put during movement, making them a top choice for work uniforms and active teams. Unlike raglan or drop shoulder styles, the set in sleeve construction provides a clean shoulder line that layers easily under jackets or vests. With options like the Port & Company Essential Performance Tee in moisture-wicking fabric, these shirts keep your crew comfortable on the job or at the event. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a polished look that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom set in sleeve t shirts with a classic fit, available in multiple colors for bulk orders
